description:
## 2.1.2-dev.1

- fix: a dash in a comment took every Flexboard button off the toolbar

patches.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches.description: Raises the toolbar from five icons to 12, so Flexboard's hotkeys and text action buttons can fit alongside Gboard's own. How many icons actually show stays yours, set by dragging them in Gboard's toolbar settings.

patches.name: Bypass Gboard Signature
patches.description: Bypass Gboard's signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Grammar Check Row
patches.description: Force the grammar check settings row to appear. The Phenotype flag that governs it never syncs on a patched build, so its compiled-in default (off) sticks.

patches.name: Install as Gboard Clone
patches.description: Rename the package to dev.jz6.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin so the patched build installs alongside the official Gboard instead of replacing it.

patches.name: Suggested Settings
patches.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings.

patches.name: Swipe Left to Delete
patches.description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.

patches.name: Swipe Right to Undo
patches.description: Swipe right after deleting to put the words back — the swipe starts on the Delete key, or anywhere when Swipe Left to Delete is also applied. Uses Gboard's own undo, which already records what a delete swipe removed.

patches.name: Text Action Buttons
patches.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists.

patches.name: Toolbar Hotkeys
patches.description: Adds six configurable hotkey slots to Gboard's toolbar — each commits a text of your choice on tap. A slot appears when its text is set; when cleared it hides at the next toolbar rebuild (rotate, switch IME, or restart — there's no mid-session un-register). Text and icon edits apply on the next keyboard open.

patches.name: Vibration slider everywhere
patches.description: Forces Gboard to show its own vibration strength slider on every device, rather than deferring to the system haptic settings page, so the strength is adjustable instead of being fixed by whichever rollout the device landed in.

release_notes:
## 2.2.0

BIGGER TOOL BAR makes a comeback!
now native and bug free, put all your hotkeys on the toolbar!

- fix: a dash in a comment took every Flexboard button off the toolbar
- feat: Bigger Toolbar — raise the ceiling, leave the count alone
- docs: the capacity plan, and why owning the count was the mistake
- refactor: one copy of the controller-constructor prologue
- refactor: name the id-admission patch for what it admits
- feat: text action buttons mint their own ids instead of squatting
- feat: rename Toolbar Buttons to Text Action Buttons
- feat: retire Toolbar Native Test, rename Swipe to Delete
- refactor: move the toolbar engine into the toolbar feature
- refactor: fold a single-consumer helper out of shared/, keep a redundant edge
- refactor: split ToolbarRegistry along the seams it already had
- refactor: remove the parked swipe-length scaling and everything holding it up
- revert: drop the R6 lint rule, and correct what it was enforcing
- fix: resolve Flexboard's resources by name even on a renamed package
